Delete a profile entry from ~/.drt/profiles.yml.

## Usage

```bash
drt profile remove [OPTIONS] NAME
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `NAME` | yes | Profile name to remove. |

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--yes`, `-y` | `BOOLEAN` |  | Skip the confirmation prompt. |
